newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton offering low, prices steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton offering low, prices steady.

text.p: Indian cotton prices on Tuesday held steady as mill buying remained sluggish but limited inflows and a shortage of ready stock kept offerings low, dealers said.
In spot deals, Bengal-deshi was quiet at 1,030/1,070 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), Punjab saw-ginned unchanged at 1,825/1,900 rupees and F-414 at 2,060/2,090 rupees per maund.

Gujarat cotton was indicated at the previous level amid nominal trading. Gujarat Kalyan was steady at 13,900/14,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Long-staple Sankar-4 was quiet at 17,500/18,000 rupees per candy for average variety and at 20,000/20,500 rupees per candy for the superior variety.
